complete_examples.text: The wheels are constantly kept contact with the rails in most situa-tions; therefore, the wheel–rail coupling matrices that consider the wheelset’s vertical displacement as nonindependent will be presented here as an emphasis.
Following the “set-in-right-position” rule [34], the wheel–rail coupling matrices will be partitioned into the vehicle matrices and rail matrices.
The vehicle and the curved tracks are dynamically coupled by time-dependent wheel–rail coupling matrices [22–24].

To form unified train–track interaction system and to pre-pare for track–substructure interaction, the wheel–rail coupling matrices and the interaction matrices between the track and substructures are required.
